summary: Both prior blockers resolved: contract limit recalibrated to 400 with sound rationale, diff 352/400 passes; misleading mutation-guard comment fixed.
notes: Re-ran quorum analyze contract-check against HEAD bf41978 with changed_files=[docs/bitacora-de-descartes.md, sidecar/arranque.go, sidecar/arranque_test.go, sidecar/main.go], diff_stat={insertions:291, deletions:61}: ok=true, violations=[], not_checked=[forbid.behaviors]. 02-contract.yaml's max_diff_lines rationale judged sound: contract-check sums insertions+deletions, and this task is a pure extraction (main.go loses ~60 lines that arranque.go gains as ~124 new lines plus a 121-line test file), so every migrated line of logic is counted twice by construction, not because new logic was added. The recalibration is honestly recorded in-line in 02-contract.yaml (states the old estimate reasoned on net lines and was therefore short) and cross-referenced in 05-validation.json's third command excerpt, which also flags the previous validation summary's own understatement (insertions-only) as a separate finding rather than hiding it.

Restored arranque.go afterward; git status confirms a clean working tree.
Ran cd sidecar && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1 directly: all packages pass, matching 05-validation.json's recorded exit codes.

Confirmed docs/bitacora-de-descartes.md's D-43 and D-44 entries are unchanged from the previously-reviewed state (present, sequential, indexed) -- this amendment did not touch the bitacora, so that finding is carried forward, not re-derived.

Carried forward without re-verification (unchanged by this amendment, already confirmed in the prior review pass): the audit conclusion that identidad.db is the only read-before-create hazard in main.go's cold-start sequence, the five defers' LIFO order and declaration site in main(), the forbid.behaviors item-by-item manual check (no go.mod/go.sum/ADR/STATUS.md touch, extraction stops at buzon, no new intra-function cleanup, sqlstore ordering preserved), and the overall correctness of the reordering fix itself.

No new blocker found.
